import string

# Derive the new alphabet: English letters without c and m, then c, then m.
ALPHA = [ch for ch in string.ascii_lowercase if ch not in "cm"] + ["c", "m"]
assert len(ALPHA) == 26 and sorted(ALPHA) == list(string.ascii_lowercase)
rank = {ch: i for i, ch in enumerate(ALPHA)}

words = [
    "medea", "oversimplifications", "clonic", "chaplin", "kennan", "postpone",
    "squabble", "ipsilateral", "misunderstandings", "ussr", "canal",
    "modifications", "referring", "counterrevolutionaries", "pyridine",
    "cameroon", "avalanche", "rationalizations", "fortran", "cram", "coachman",
]
assert all(w.isalpha() and w.islower() for w in words)
assert len(set(words)) == len(words)

# Method 1: tuple of alphabet ranks, lexicographic (prefix sorts first).
def key(w):
    return tuple(rank[ch] for ch in w)

sorted_words = sorted(words, key=key)

# Strict-order check on adjacent pairs.
strict = all(key(a) < key(b) for a, b in zip(sorted_words, sorted_words[1:]))

# Method 2: translate each letter to its a-z position, then plain string sort.
TABLE = {ord(ch): chr(97 + rank[ch]) for ch in ALPHA}
translated_sorted = sorted(words, key=lambda w: w.translate(TABLE))
methods_agree = translated_sorted == sorted_words

print("Derived alphabet:", ", ".join(ch.upper() for ch in ALPHA))
print("Sorted words:", ", ".join(sorted_words))
print("Strict order on adjacent pairs:", strict)
print("Two independent sort methods agree:", methods_agree)
print("CHECK PASS (sort is exact and consistent)" if strict and methods_agree
      else "CHECK FAIL (sort inconsistency)")

# The submitted answer.
CLAIM = "A, B, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, N, O, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W, X, Y, Z, C, M"
claim_letters = [x.strip().lower() for x in CLAIM.split(",")]

alphabet_matches = claim_letters == ALPHA
print("Claimed letter order matches derived alphabet:", alphabet_matches)
print("CHECK PASS (alphabet portion)" if alphabet_matches
      else "CHECK FAIL (alphabet portion)")

# The task asks for the sorted words; the claim contains no words at all.
claim_has_words = any(w in CLAIM.lower() for w in words)
print("Claim contains any of the input words:", claim_has_words)
print("CHECK FAIL (submitted answer is an alphabet, not the sorted word list)"
      if not claim_has_words else "CHECK UNKNOWN (word list present, compare manually)")
